alert.description: p99 latency above 2000ms for 5 consecutive minutes (SLO: 500ms)

hypotheses.title: Bad deploy regression (v2.14.3)
evidence: Deploy completed at 2026-10-01T14:07:12Z, ~25m before the alert.
Timeout/pool-exhaustion errors appeared only after the deploy.
CPU stayed flat — not a resource-saturation issue.
remediation: Roll back payments-api to v2.14.2 immediately.
Roll back to the previous stable version.
Confirm p99 recovers within 10 minutes of rollback.
Diff v2.14.2..v2.14.3 focusing on DB query/connection changes.

hypotheses.title: Downstream dependency slowdown
evidence: Latency spike pattern also matches a slow dependency.
remediation: Check trace spans for the slowest downstream call.
Enable circuit breaker / shed load on the slow path.

hypotheses.title: Traffic surge
evidence: CPU flat and no request-rate data in this demo — cannot confirm a surge.
remediation: Scale out horizontally if a surge is confirmed.

top_recommendation: Roll back payments-api to v2.14.2 immediately.
